title: UAV-Based Computer Vision for Cattle Detection and Feed Bunk Spatial Analysis
summary: YOLOv8 and YOLOv11 detected cattle in UAV imagery, and YOLOv8 small supported downstream spatial analysis with the Segment Anything Model used to segment feed-bunk regions. In one commercial feedlot dataset, derived metrics distinguished representative regular and irregular cattle distributions. The study reports no animal handling or intervention.
ai_technology: YOLOv8/YOLOv11 object detectors; Segment Anything Model
organization: University of São Paulo; Federal University of Grande Dourados; Embrapa Digital Agriculture

evidence.tested: In a dataset collected during commercial feedlot UAV flights, YOLOv8 small achieved 84.30% mAP50; geometric metrics distinguished representative regular and irregular cattle distributions.
evidence.unknown: One feedlot dataset was studied; the metrics were not linked to measured animal welfare or production outcomes.
evidence.ai_role: YOLOv8/YOLOv11 detected cattle; YOLOv8 small detections supported spatial measures, and Segment Anything Model segmented the feed-bunk region.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
